notablePrerequisites:
At least two +1/+1 counters on Ulasht.
You control a basic land.
description:
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Ulasht by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Ulasht, creating a 1/1 Saporling creature token.
The Saproling token enters triggering Ivy Lane Denizen, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ulasht.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Saporling token, untapping the basic land.
Repeat.
